review_locator: PMCID:PMC7294228, Intestinal neuro-immune interactions: focus on macrophages, mast cells and innate lymphoid cells; PMCID:PMC7395873, Activation and suppression of group 3 innate lymphoid cells in the gut
primary_title: Glial-cell-derived neuroregulators control type 3 innate lymphoid cells and gut defence
decision_basis: The reviews identify the primary study showing glial-derived GDNF-family ligands activate RET-expressing intestinal ILC3s and induce IL-22 production.
limitations_preserved: Preserve GDNF-family ligand/GFRalpha/RET multicomponent context and mouse intestinal ILC3 model; the primary includes family/pair-level stimulation and no single GFL is claimed here; distinguish measured IL-22 protein/output from Il22 transcription; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7294228, Intestinal neuro-immune interactions: focus on macrophages, mast cells and innate lymphoid cells; PMCID:PMC7395873, Activation and suppression of group 3 innate lymphoid cells in the gut
primary_title: Glial-cell-derived neuroregulators control type 3 innate lymphoid cells and gut defence
decision_basis: The reviews identify the primary study showing GDNF-family/RET stimulation increases Il22 transcription in intestinal ILC3s downstream of ERK-AKT/p38 and STAT3 activation.
limitations_preserved: Record Il22 as a gene-transcription output supported by qPCR/STAT3 occupancy, not automatically as secreted IL-22 protein; preserve GDNF-family/GFRalpha/RET and mouse intestinal ILC3 context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC13058849, Neuro-immune interactions in the intestine; PMCID:PMC13198743, Group 2 innate lymphoid cell review
primary_title: CGRP-related neuropeptide adrenomedullin 2 promotes tissue-protective ILC2 responses and limits intestinal inflammation
decision_basis: The review identifies the primary study showing recombinant ADM2 elicits AREG-positive intestinal ILC2s through the ADM2 receptor pathway.
limitations_preserved: Use AREG-positive cell frequency as the measured output, not an unmeasured AREG transcript or protein-secretion step; preserve mouse large-intestine ILC2, 72-hour ADM2 treatment and CALCRL/RAMP receptor-subunit context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6474201, Sensing of physiological regulators by innate lymphoid cells; PMCID:PMC7658006, Neural Regulation of Interactions Between Group 2 Innate Lymphoid Cells and Pulmonary Immune Cells
primary_title: beta2-adrenergic receptor-mediated negative regulation of group 2 innate lymphoid cell responses
decision_basis: The reviews identify the primary study showing beta2-adrenergic receptor signaling is a cell-intrinsic negative regulator of ILC2 proliferation.
limitations_preserved: Use the ADRB2 pathway, agonist and receptor-deficiency evidence at the bounded mouse ILC2 proliferation layer; do not claim norepinephrine was the directly tested agonist in every assay or transfer to SCI; no terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6474201, Sensing of physiological regulators by innate lymphoid cells; PMCID:PMC7658006, Neural Regulation of Interactions Between Group 2 Innate Lymphoid Cells and Pulmonary Immune Cells
primary_title: beta2-adrenergic receptor-mediated negative regulation of group 2 innate lymphoid cell responses
decision_basis: The reviews identify the primary study showing beta2-adrenergic receptor signaling suppresses ILC2 effector cytokine production and type 2 inflammation.
limitations_preserved: Encode suppression of the measured IL-5/IL-13 ILC2 effector output rather than a specific unmeasured intracellular mechanism; preserve mouse tissue and agonist/receptor-deficiency context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6959098, Group 2 Innate Lymphoid Cells in Human Respiratory Disorders; PMCID:PMC6474201, Sensing of physiological regulators by innate lymphoid cells
primary_title: Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells amplify allergic asthma responses
decision_basis: The reviews identify the primary study showing pulmonary neuroendocrine-cell-associated CGRP, with IL-33, increases IL-5 secretion by primary mouse lung ILC2s.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the PNEC-derived CGRP source context, IL-33 co-stimulus and mouse lung ILC2 supernatant ELISA; the primary also uses exogenous CGRP and does not prove a PNEC co-culture transfer step; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6959098, Group 2 Innate Lymphoid Cells in Human Respiratory Disorders; PMCID:PMC6474201, Sensing of physiological regulators by innate lymphoid cells
primary_title: Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells amplify allergic asthma responses
decision_basis: The reviews identify the primary study showing CGRP further increases IL-5 secretion from primary mouse lung ILC2s stimulated with IL-25 plus IL-33.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the IL-25 plus IL-33 co-stimulus, PNEC-derived CGRP source context and mouse lung ILC2 supernatant ELISA; this is a conditioned-output edge, not evidence for a PNEC co-culture or an unmeasured Calca transcription/secretion step; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
